analysis.title: Nomura - McElligott - QUICK MENTIONS - 10 Nov 2026
key_insights: Fed's Waller said he could support a 50bps hike in December if today's CPI prints hot, which moved a December Fed hike to fully priced.
A large +26k Tuesday weekly 10Y put buyer came in ahead of the CPI release as 'hot CPI insurance' expiring the same day. Prior open interest in that strike was 1080.
Rate vol fell sharply on Monday on the oil price drop, continued Iran terms headlines and further removal of election risk premium.
After the recent rally in Treasuries, real money accounts have tilted to selling further out the curve, and momentum in receivers has faded as the rally stalls.
McElligott ties the unwillingness to hold long vol or long gamma to poor performance across the market, which leaves little tolerance for bleed.
Equity breadth on Monday was very strong: 424 S&P 500 stocks rose and 79 fell, so 84% closed higher, and the rally broadened across sectors and industries.
The main story on Monday was the vol crush, with VIX falling from 28 to 20 over about 2.5 sessions.

Dealer books had become short customer-bought puts and OTM puts after Thursday's equity crash, with skew elevated and vol of vol very high. The vol drop forced dealers to buy back short delta and futures, which made a large part of Monday's rally mechanical through vanna.
As spot rose, calls bought for a bounce moved closer to the money and added more delta for dealers to buy.
Today the vol decline has stalled and the stock rally has stalled with it.
Record options volumes, vol-scaling strategies and leveraged ETF end-of-day rebalancing (synthetic negative gamma) add to two-way moves and over-realization of volatility.
The 10-day and 20-day realized volatility of VVIX are at record highs on a 10-year lookback, above COVID, Liberation Day and Volmageddon. Dean Curnutt of MRA made the same observation.
McElligott treats VVIX as a proxy for demand for wings and tails, and reads last week as a panicky grab for convexity as the market repriced the macro and vol regime.
He accepts the backtest that says to sell rich vol, but expects continued whipsaw and suggests moving to a wider straddle.
He expects the VIX floor to be dragged incrementally higher as larger daily ranges are priced, citing uncertainty over AI capex and its effects on equities, rates and credit.

Stalled vol decline could end the mechanical, vanna-driven equity rally.

10- and 20-day realized volatility of VVIX are at record highs on a 10-year lookback, above COVID, Liberation Day and Volmageddon.
A +26k Tuesday weekly 10Y put purchase was made ahead of CPI, against prior open interest of 1080.
Record options volumes, vol-scaling strategies and leveraged ETF rebalancing add pro-cyclical, two-way price moves.
